svg.text: Sitka Standard: 20-day veg, Saturday cuts (default built-in) — three lots in one flower room, 70 days apart
Day 0 = clones cut (Saturday). Plant +14 · transplant +30 (Mon) · flip +34 (Fri) · harvest +97 (Fri, one day) · next lot cut at harvest −27 (Sat) and moves in the Monday after harvest.
Shaded columns = Fridays (harvest and flip day). Dates start Sat Oct 24, 2026 as an example.
Lot A harvested Fri Jan 29 → Lot B in Mon Feb 01
Lot B harvested Fri Apr 09 → Lot C in Mon Apr 12

Flower room: each lot holds it from transplant (Mon) to Tank & Irrigation Clean (Sun after harvest), so it is never empty — the next lot moves in the next day. Every room is used once per 70 days; weekdays repeat exactly each cycle.
